keys.model: Model used by default (alias such as opus, sonnet, haiku, or full identifier).
keys.effortLevel: Default reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Overridden by --effort or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL.
keys.theme: Interface color theme (dark, light, colorblind or ANSI variants…).
keys.editorMode: Input box key bindings: normal or vim.
keys.cleanupPeriodDays: Days to keep session transcripts before cleanup. A huge value means never deleting them.
keys.env: Environment variables applied to every session and its subprocesses; they override the shell's, unless the launch already sets them.
keys.attribution: What Claude adds to commits (commit) and pull requests (pr), and whether the session link is added (sessionUrl). Empty: nothing is added.
keys.attributionCommit: Text appended to the end of the commit message. Empty: no attribution line.
keys.attributionPr: Text added to the description of a pull request.
keys.permissionsAllow: Allowed rule: the tool runs without asking. E.g. Bash(git status:*) allows every form of "git status".
keys.permissionsAsk: Rule to confirm: always asks, even if a broader rule allows.
keys.permissionsDeny: Denied rule: never run; overrides allow and ask.
keys.permissionsDefaultMode: Permission mode at startup (default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, bypassPermissions).
keys.hooks: Commands run by Claude Code on certain events (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionStart, InstructionsLoaded…). They run with your rights.
keys.worktree: Settings for the git worktrees created by Claude (little documented).
keys.workflowKeywordTriggerEnabled: Allows a keyword in the prompt to launch a multi-agent workflow.
keys.enabledPlugins: Plugins enabled or not, in the name@marketplace format: true or false.
keys.extraKnownMarketplaces: Plugin marketplaces added on top of the default ones.
keys.feedbackDrafts: Feedback drafts Claude may queue: notify, quiet or off.
keys.modelSettings: Settings specific to certain models (little documented).
keys.promptSuggestionEnabled: Greyed-out prompt suggestions in the input box (on by default).
keys.awaySummaryEnabled: One-line recap of the session when you come back to the terminal.
keys.dialogExpiry: Delay (e.g. 5m) of dialogs forwarded to a remote client and of message approvals between sessions, before the default action.
keys.pluginConfigs: Non-sensitive plugin options, by plugin identifier.
keys.skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt: Do not show the warning before the no-permission mode (bypassPermissions).
keys.skipWorkflowUsageWarning: Do not show the warning about workflow consumption.
keys.autoCompactEnabled: Automatically compacts the conversation when the context nears its limit.
keys.idleCompaction: Compacts the conversation of an idle session before the prompt cache expires.
keys.fileCheckpointingEnabled: Saves files before each Claude edit: this is what makes /rewind work. Disabled: no way back.
keys.teammateMode: Where teammate agents run: auto, in-process (in the main terminal) or tmux (separate panes).
keys.remoteControlAtStartup: Enables remote control of the session at startup (little documented).
keys.crossSessionInbound: What to do with messages sent by another session: accept, hold (waiting for your approval) or refuse.
keys.inputNeededNotifEnabled: Notification when Claude is waiting for input from you (little documented).
keys.useAutoModeDuringPlan: Keeps the auto mode classifier active during plan mode. Disabled: any command that is not read-only asks for confirmation.
keys.autoMode: Auto mode classifier rules: the repository context it knows (environment) and what it must refuse (soft_deny).
keys.autoModeEnvironment: A fact about your environment (repository, secrets, protected branches, network) that the auto mode classifier takes into account.
keys.autoModeSoftDeny: An action the auto mode must refuse; $defaults brings in the built-in refusals.
keys.autoModeAllow: An action the auto mode may accept without asking.
keys.envVar: Environment variable {{name}}: value given to every session.
